question: What does the speaker promise to explain to the beautiful-eyed listener?
premises: The speaker will speak about them.
The topic is the method of their names.
The listener is urged to hear.
inference: The speaker will explain the method of their names.
uncertainties: The referent of teṣāṃ depends on prior context.
plain_english: I shall speak the method of their names; listen, O beautiful-eyed one.
